title: Moderate-interest debt
summary: Same threshold logic. Business debt with deductible interest gets evaluated at its after-tax rate.
detailsHtml: For most contractors, moderate-interest debt sits in the 5–7% range — auto loans, some personal loans, some business lines of credit. The decision is whether prepayment beats expected after-tax investment return on the alternative use of funds.
